speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Tendon Avulsion/Laceration at the Distal Interphalangeal Joint).

The clinical presentation of pain, inability to flex the DIP joint, and the finger resting in extension following a forced flexion injury is classic for this condition. I have already requested an X-ray to rule out an avulsion fracture; please confirm if you can actively extend the fingertip against gravity.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
